title: The Workflow Run and G4: the twelve steps read from a run's records, a calibrator fitted out of fold, a monitoring plan in the artifact, an export that checks itself, and the gate that sends a run back
request: Phase 8 (the owner's framework, phase 4): the twelve steps with their checks, the calibrator, the export test run per kind, the monitoring plan in the artifact, GateResult loop-backs the coordinator follows.
plan: Map what exists: the engine's five stages against the twelve steps, the exports, the drift smoke check, the gates.
Write the contracts in the library: the twelve steps, a gate's verdict with the phase it sends back to, G4, a calibrator, a monitoring plan and monitor().
Wire the engine: the simple model on the screen's folds, the calibrator and the plan at the final stage, G4 in both final paths, its ledger point; the team follows a failed G4.
Make each export check itself and carry the calibrator and the plan; write the code export for the three kinds that had none.

decisions.decision: The twelve steps are read from the records a run already writes; a step the records do not show is missing, never assumed done.
decisions.why: A step claimed done without its evidence is what the framework's gate exists to catch.

decisions.decision: The calibrator is chosen on the out-of-fold scores' own folds and fitted on all of them; served beside the score, never instead of it.
decisions.why: Nothing about the holdout may shape it, and the ranking and the threshold stay what was validated.

decisions.decision: The monitoring plan watches the model's input columns only, its category levels hashed in the service export and its edges between training values.
decisions.why: Identifiers, dates and blocked columns alarmed on the project's own holdout, and a plan of raw levels and row values would carry the table into an artifact that promises none.

decisions.decision: G4's gap is read against the folds' value with a floor on a 0 to 1 scale, twice the folds' spread, or the holdout's interval.
decisions.why: An absolute bound let a score near zero collapse unnoticed and failed small errors measured in their own units.

decisions.decision: A failed G4 stops the team with the phase it names; a person decides there.
decisions.why: The work goes back to a brief, a split or the data, none of which an agent may change on its own.

change: dclab_core.workflow_run (STEPS, RunStep, WorkflowRun v1, GateResult v1, g4), dclab_core.calibration (Calibrator v1, fit, apply, brier), dclab_core.monitoring (MonitoringPlan v1, MonitorReport v1, plan, monitor, midpoint edges); the engine's _dummy_cv, _calibration_fit, _monitoring_plan and G4 with the ledger point workflow.g4; dclab_rnd.studio.workflow_run (g4_of, machine_monitoring, build, view) and GET /api/projects/{id}/workflow-run; the service export's calibrator, hashed monitoring.json, reload check and exports record; the scorer's calibrated_probability, monitor() and integer types; the code export's monitoring.json, check and the ranking, segmentation and uplift makers; the team's stop on G4 with back_to; dclab-core 0.91.0.

findings.scenario: An mae of 7.0 against the folds' 6.5 failed: the gap bound was absolute.
findings.fix: The gap read against the folds' value on an unscaled metric.

findings.defect: G4 was never recorded in the ledger.
findings.cause: Its state fields were not in the ledger's vocabulary and the refusal was quiet.
findings.fix: The fields declared as flags and codes.

findings.scenario: The regression replica's MAE 8.46 against the folds' 8.66 failed 'A rule to act on'; the team stopped and the report said G4 does not pass.
findings.cause: The regression kind's task type is timeseries_regression, never regression.
findings.fix: A number predicted is read from the kind's base task in the rule, the plan's score and the simple model's name.

findings.defect: The binary kind's service export was refused by its own check.
findings.scenario: Every one of 600 holdout rows differed by up to 0.0367.
findings.cause: The scorer turned integer columns into objects, so the recipe built other features: a fault the new check caught.
findings.fix: The training integer type kept when nothing is missing.

findings.defect: The monitoring plan watched columns the model never reads.
findings.scenario: The project's own holdout alerted on the row number, the order id, the date and the biker id.
findings.cause: The plan was built on every column of the training rows.
findings.fix: The model's feature columns only, a person's left out.

findings.defect: The service would ship the table's values in its monitoring file.
findings.scenario: Plain category levels, and decile edges equal to order ids and biker ids.
findings.cause: Quantiles return a row's own value; levels were kept as they are.
findings.fix: Edges at midpoints between training values; levels hashed with the export key, the scorer hashing its inputs the same way.

findings.defect: A machine kind's plan kept a person's values.
findings.scenario: The anomaly replica's record held the top phone numbers, on every row, the time column included.
findings.cause: No personal columns passed, no time left out.
findings.fix: Personal and time columns left out, the training rows when the machine has them.

findings.defect: G4's gap rule was wrong both ways.
findings.scenario: Average precision 0.09 then 0.01 passed; small errors with no interval failed.
findings.cause: An absolute bound on a 0 to 1 scale, no spread.
findings.fix: A floor on a 0 to 1 scale, twice the folds' spread, or the holdout's interval.

findings.scenario: A rerun final after an export, or a refused re-export, still read as packaged.
findings.cause: The export's record never named the final it packaged.
findings.fix: Each export records the final's run; a refused one is forgotten.

findings.defect: The reload check could fail untidily and showed the key.
findings.scenario: A timeout or an empty output escaped and left the folder; the key was on the command line.
findings.cause: Only a non-zero exit was handled.
findings.fix: Every failure refuses the export and removes the folder; the key by the environment; full float precision.

findings.defect: An export's record was written outside the validator.
findings.scenario: No move logged when an export changed the project.
findings.fix: The export is the graph's capture move, logged.

findings.defect: The team lost the phase it was sent back to.
findings.cause: LangGraph drops a key its state does not name.
findings.fix: back_to in the state and in the result, tested through a real run.

findings.defect: A NaN holdout read as leakage.
findings.scenario: 'reaches 0.995: a column likely gives the answer away'.
findings.fix: A value that is not finite is unread.

findings.defect: Two report lines said what was not so.
findings.scenario: 'calibrated by none'; 'outside the holdout's interval' with no interval.
findings.cause: Written whatever the method and the interval.
findings.fix: 'not calibrated' with the reason; the interval named only when there is one.

findings.defect: The monitor flagged a real shift on the delivery replica's holdout.
findings.scenario: status: the training rows hold only DELIVERED, five in a hundred holdout rows are CANCELLED.
findings.cause: The rows the model learned from never held a cancelled ride: a true finding, not a fault.
findings.fix: Kept as the monitor's honest alert; the test names it.

measurements.name: the three kinds' code reproducing their holdout
measurements.gate: the Done when: the export test passes for every kind
measurements.result: ranking, segmentation and uplift: pipeline.py in an isolated Python reproduced each holdout number
measurements.against_gate: the kinds that refused a code export now export one that recomputes the number

measurements.name: the service export per service kind
measurements.gate: the Done when: the export test passes for every kind
measurements.result: binary, multiclass, regression and delivery fraud reloaded in an isolated Python and matched
limits: Kinds with their own machine have no service export; their code export is their artifact.

outcome: A run says which of the framework's twelve steps it took and where each one's evidence is; its artifact carries a calibrated probability and a monitoring plan without a value of the table; it proves it reloads and predicts what was validated; and G4 sends a run back to the phase that must change.
lessons: A check that compares an artifact against the engine finds faults the artifact had all along: read its first refusal as a finding, not a flake.
Read a kind's task type through its base task: a string compared by hand misses the kinds that name theirs differently.
risks: G4 fails on the time-to-event, uplift and embedded replicas (their folds do not explain their holdout, or a perfect score); the verdicts are honest on these seeds and not yet pinned per kind.
Kinds with their own machine have no service export.
